_doc: Language-neutral CLI cases for the hook twins (#475). Both runners spawn each hook as a process and must see the same exit code, with `expectStderr` somewhere in stderr: adapters/js/hooks/__tests__/hook-cases.test.mjs and adapters/python/hooks/test_hook_cases.py. Each run starts from the test process's environment with every PLUMBLINE_* variable and PYTHONIOENCODING removed. `cfg` is JSON-encoded into PLUMBLINE_CFG; `env` then sets variables (null unsets one), so a raw PLUMBLINE_CFG string goes in `env`. `stdin` is written as UTF-8; `stdinHex` gives raw bytes instead; neither means empty stdin. Commands in PLUMBLINE_TEST_CMD are POSIX utilities, so neither runner needs the other language. This file, not prose, is the hook parity contract (adapters/adapter-contract.md, Hook I/O convention).
